title: Chitthi Studio — Roadmap
lead: Phased plan. Each phase is a set of feature specs. Statuses change with `npm run specs -- status`.
intro:
The what and why for the editor phases is in [vision/editor-roadmap.md](vision/editor-roadmap.md); the original work
items (files, tests, notes and measurements for Phases 0–1) are in
[vision/editor-implementation.md](vision/editor-implementation.md). From Phase 2 on, each work item is a feature
folder here and this file holds its status. Numbers follow the work-item IDs: **P2.1 → 201**, **P3.4 → 304**.

baseline.title: Baseline — what exists before SDD
baseline.goal: record the app as it stands (2.8.0 plus the unreleased editor Phases 0–1) and close the Phase 1 gate.
baseline.exit:
every Definition-of-Done gate passes on a clean clone; the Phase 1 gate in
[editor-implementation.md](vision/editor-implementation.md#progress) is met and 2.10.0 is released.

phase-2.title: Phase 2 — Multi-track timeline (release 3.0.0)
phase-2.goal: a real timeline with tracks, edit tools, keyframes, transitions, speed and audio.
phase-2.exit:
a 4K multi-track timeline (3 video and 2 audio tracks, transitions) plays smoothly on desktop;
every 2.x project opens unchanged.

phase-3.title: Phase 3 — Colour and finishing (release 3.1.0)
phase-3.goal: a colour page with scopes, captions, retouching, and professional outputs on desktop.
phase-3.exit:
none set yet (the editor roadmap marks it the last phase); the first Phase 3 spec proposes a
measurable one.

other.title: Other features (400+)
other.intro: Print studio, site and anything outside the editor phases take the next free number from 401.

202.title: Edit operations: ripple, roll, slip, slide, magnetic main track, snapping

210.title: Markers, in/out, range export, text animations, compound clips

211.title: Proxies and frame cache, desktop first

212.title: Agent tools and docs for the timeline

302.title: Grading curves and secondaries, HSL qualifier

304.title: Grade tools: copy/paste, timeline LUT, match clips

305.title: Auto captions, on-device speech model — licence check first

307.title: Professional outputs on desktop: FFmpeg helper, 10-bit, HDR — licence exception first

308.title: AI object removal, desktop — model licence first

309.title: Agent tools and docs for grading, scopes, captions

401.title: AI models on this device: see and delete downloaded models

404.title: Roadmap data (JSON) and a roadmap dashboard on localhost

405.title: Roadmap dashboard revamp: a scrollable road, motion and live task progress

000.title: Baseline: print studio, photo & video studio, desktop app, MCP, AI, GPU render graph (editor P0.1–P0.9), advanced photo editor (P1.1–P1.12)

001.title: Phase 1 gate and 2.10.0 release: masked edits measured on a mid-range laptop in Chrome; first macOS build with Intel LibRaw; tag 2.10.0

001-hardware-checks.text:
**Deferred 001 checks on the maintainer's hardware** (2026-10-06; 001 and the 2.10.0 release wait for them):
the Phase 1 gate on a mid-range laptop in Chrome (`npm run measure:gate`, plus `npm test`'s timing and the
performance monitor in the packaged app: 001 T022, T023); the Intel LibRaw build and RAW files in the arm64 and x64
macOS apps (T030, T033). Then the release itself: T040 version and CHANGELOG, T041 merge into `main`, T042 dry run,
T043 tag `v2.10.0`, T044–T047 clean installs, update from 2.8.0, web redeploy. How: the 👤 tasks in
[001 tasks](features/001-phase1-gate-release/tasks.md).

webkit-firefox-e2e.text: Firefox and Safari (WebKit) projects in Playwright ([testing-strategy.md](testing-strategy.md#not-automated-yet)).
